panel: Verify your World of Tanks account to receive the player role and use your in-game nickname on this server.
login_prompt: Use this private link within 10 minutes. Only connect your own account.
success: Account verified. You can return to Discord.
synced: Your player role and World of Tanks nickname are up to date.
unlinked: Your account link, player role and any clan contact role have been removed. Any clan contact nickname suffix has been removed.
not_linked: No matching account link was found.
already_linked: This Discord or Wargaming account is already linked. Use /unlink first, or contact an administrator.
invalid_state: This verification link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new link in Discord.
wg_error: Wargaming could not verify your account. Please try again later.
discord_error: Discord could not complete the operation. Contact an administrator to check bot permissions or server membership, then try again.
error: The operation could not be completed. Please try again or contact an administrator.
wrong_server: This bot is only available in its configured server.
admin_only: Only server administrators can use this command.
setup_done: The verification panel has been posted.
rejoined: Your player role has been restored. Run /resync in the server to refresh your World of Tanks nickname.
confirm_unlink: Run /unlink confirm:True to remove your player role, any clan contact role and your account link.
bad_target: Provide exactly one Discord user ID or Wargaming account ID.
not_ready: The bot is starting. Please try again shortly.
return_hint: You can close this page once you are back in Discord.
linked_incomplete: Your Wargaming account is verified and linked. Discord could not finish updating your player role or nickname. Contact an administrator if you need help, then use /resync to try again.
nickname_blocked: Your Wargaming account is verified and linked, and your player role is in place. Discord prevented the nickname update, which can happen when your highest role is above the bot or you own the server. You can keep your current nickname; no role hierarchy change is required. Use /resync if permissions change later.
nickname_error: Your Wargaming account is verified and linked, and your player role is in place. The nickname update could not be completed. Use /resync in Discord to try again later.
clan_success: Your clan contact role and nickname have been updated.
clan_taken: This clan already has a contact. Please ask a moderator for a manual verification.
clan_review: Your clan contact needs a manual review. Please contact a moderator; no role or clan slot has been changed.
clan_ineligible: You must be a clan Commander, Executive Officer or Recruitment Officer to become its contact.
clan_not_linked: Connect your Wargaming account first, then use this button again.
clan_disabled: Clan contacts are not configured yet. Please contact a moderator.
clan_discord_error: Discord could not update the clan contact role. Please contact a moderator to check bot permissions and role hierarchy, then retry.
clan_nickname_error: Your clan contact role is assigned and the clan slot is reserved, but Discord could not update your nickname. Ask a moderator to check permissions, then retry this button or /resync.
clan_name_long: Your World of Tanks nickname with the clan tag exceeds Discord’s 32-character limit. Please ask a moderator for a manual verification.
clan_removed: The clan contact role, reservation and nickname suffix have been removed. Your account link is kept.
clan_player_required: You must have the player role before becoming a clan contact. Please verify or resync your account first.
clan_tag_cleanup_error: The clan contact role and reservation are removed, but Discord could not remove the clan tag from your nickname. Ask a moderator to check permissions, then retry /admin_contact_remove.
unlinked_tag_pending: Your account link, player role and clan contact role have been removed. Discord could not remove the clan tag from your nickname. Ask a moderator to check permissions and retry /admin_contact_remove.
command_admin_contact_remove: Remove a clan contact role and free the clan slot after review
command_setup: Post the Wargaming verification panel in this channel
command_resync: Refresh your player role and World of Tanks nickname
command_unlink: Remove your account link and player role
command_admin_unlink: Remove a link by Discord user ID or Wargaming account ID
panel_updated: The verification panel has been updated.
panel_elsewhere: The verification panel already exists in <#{channel_id}>. Run /setup there. To move it, delete the old message first.
panel_inaccessible: The saved panel cannot be checked. Restore the bot’s access and Read Message History permission before retrying; no duplicate was posted.
